description: You feel the tide the way other people feel weather.  Your eye for it is sharper, and so is the ache when it turns.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: PERCEPTION add 1

description: The tide does not stay in you.  Your pool is shallow, and long workings run dry early.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: MAX_MANA add -200

description: You hold a deep pool of tide and spend it slowly.  It refills like a cistern, not a stream.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: MAX_MANA add 400; REGEN_MANA multiply -0.4

description: Spoken workings leave you faster than they should.  Every spell you cast is a little quicker for it.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: CASTING_TIME_MULTIPLIER multiply -0.15

description: Your gestures are small and sure, and your hands do not wander.  Workings come off you a little faster.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: CASTING_TIME_MULTIPLIER multiply -0.1; DEXTERITY add 1

description: Crossing a gate leaves you wrong for a while, and some days the wrongness never quite leaves.  You are slower on your feet.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: SPEED add -15

description: The guild's mark is on you, ink or scar.  People who know the Craft take you for one of theirs.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: SOCIAL_PERSUADE multiply 0.15

description: Written tide means nothing to you.  A rune is a smudge.  You cannot use them, and the points come back for it.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: no engine flag yet; text only

description: Your workings announce themselves.  They take a little longer, and anything nearby knows a spell just happened.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: CASTING_TIME_MULTIPLIER multiply 0.1

description: You learned rites at a kitchen table, not in a hall.  Your pool is modest.  Small hurts close a little faster.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: MAX_MANA add -100; REGEN_HP multiply 0.1

description: Your pool is ordinary and it comes back fast, like a cup left in the rain.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: REGEN_MANA multiply 0.25

description: You do not taste the tide.  Bearings that other delvers feel, you have to measure.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: PERCEPTION add -2

description: Hexing bites you harder than it bites them.  You heal a little slower all the time, not only after a curse.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: REGEN_HP multiply -0.15

description: You learned to cast without shifting your weight.  You are harder to notice when you keep still.
//: Grok WP-C3 (tide and Craft); effects: STEALTH_MODIFIER add 15

description: You were born where the air is hot ash.  Cold bothers you less than it should, and heat less still.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: CLIMATE_CONTROL_HEAT add 20

description: You were born in the cold that keeps the dead.  Chill settles on you and then leaves you alone.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: CLIMATE_CONTROL_CHILL add 20

description: You grew up where the road is water half the day.  Swimming costs you less breath.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: MOVECOST_SWIM_MOD multiply -0.2

description: You grew up where the floor is a branch.  Rough going and low obstacles slow you less.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: MOVECOST_OBSTACLE_MOD multiply -0.15

description: You were raised where the lamps are a kindness, not a given.  Darkness does not close your sight as hard.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: NIGHT_VIS add 8

description: You grew up counting water.  Thirst comes for you more slowly than it should.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: THIRST multiply -0.2

description: Your flesh closes the way the living ground does.  It costs you water.  You are often thirsty.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: REGEN_HP multiply 0.2; THIRST multiply 0.15

description: You learned to talk under a toll and a curfew.  People believe you a little more than they mean to.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: SOCIAL_PERSUADE multiply 0.2

description: You learned to leave before the ground fails.  You are a little quicker, and you do not trust floors.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: SPEED add 8

description: You grew up where two peoples watch the same water.  You slip a blow more often than a townsfolk would.
//: Grok WP-C3 (plane heritage); effects: BONUS_DODGE add 1
